pr_body:
Implements ADR 0139 authoritative Editor working-copy and saved-copy coherency on current main while preserving ADR 0138 Animation Graph debug provenance.

- keeps existing workspace and specialized editor sessions as the single mutable owners
- supplies immutable working-copy snapshots to Problems validation, Scene View, and Play
- removes Material canonical autosave and makes persistence explicit through Save/Save All
- makes Animation Set consume an open Animation Graph working copy
- detects external saved-copy changes, automatically reloads only clean specialized editors, and requires explicit discard for dirty conflicts
- preserves semantic GraphId/EdgeId observation metadata while compiling unsaved Animation Graph snapshots
- updates Scene View and Material tests to the working-copy/explicit-save contracts
